ex.s: In artists’ representations of books and reading, we see moments of shared humanity that go beyond culture and time.
ex.t: 在艺术家对书籍和阅读的描绘中，我们看到了超越文化与时代的、人类共有的瞬间。

ex.s: More recently, as books have become inexpensive or even throwaway, artists have used them as the raw material for artworks — transforming covers, pages or even complete volumes into paintings and sculptures.
ex.t: 更近一些时候，随着书籍变得廉价甚至可以随意丢弃，艺术家们开始把它们用作艺术品的原材料——把封面、书页甚至整册书变成绘画和雕塑。

ex.s: As an artist who shares her journey on social media, I’m often asked by curious followers how to begin an art journey.

ex.s: For the images that an artist creates, viewers will probably get far more enjoyment once they know the process used to create them.
ex.t: 对于艺术家创作的图像，观众一旦知道创作它们所用的过程，就可能获得远为更多的享受。

ex.s: The project results from the difficulties many schools have in getting artists of any sort - whether an up-and-coming local musician or a major movie star - into schools to work with and inspire children.

ex.s: “We need artists . more than ever in our schools."
ex.t: 我们需要艺术家，学校里比以往任何时候都更需要他们。

ex.s: Artist Michael Craig-Martin said: “Andria's brilliant project to bring artists from all fields into direct contact with children is particularly welcome at a time when the arts are being downgraded in schools." It was a mistake to see the arts as unnecessary, he added.
ex.t: 艺术家Michael Craig-Martin说：“Andria这个将各领域艺术家与儿童直接联系起来的出色项目，在学校艺术教育被贬低之际尤其值得欢迎。”他补充说，把艺术视为可有可无是一种错误。

ex.s: Benjamin could read only a little,having been a poor student.But he later said,”Those two books were my companions by day,and under my pillow at night.”While it is likely that he understood very little of the books,they were his introduction to classical paintings.The nine-year-old boy decided then that he would be an artist.
ex.t: 本杰明只读过一点书，因为他曾是个差学生。但他后来说：“那两本书白天是我的伙伴，晚上就在我的枕头下。”虽然他很可能几乎看不懂那些书，但它们是他接触古典绘画的入门。这个九岁男孩当时就下定决心要成为一名艺术家。
